thread:
vivian (docs): Quick heads-up: SDK patch and docs note going out. We're deprecating the streaming endpoint field `prompt` in favour of `input_text`. This affects JS/Python streaming helpers and a few quickstarts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1518

omar (sdk): TL;DR impact: one-line rename in client calls. We'll ship a compat shim for 2 releases in the SDKs but recommend users migrate.

juan (eng-runtime): Runtime will accept both keys for 30 days and emit `Deprecation-Warning: prompt will be removed in 30 days` header on responses. After 30 days the server will reject `prompt` with 400.

kelly (security): No auth or token changes, just field rename. Will sign off on communications.

nina (support): I'll add KB snippets and a canned reply showing old->new examples, plus steps to troubleshoot 400s if they hit them after cutoff.

omar (sdk): Example for quick copy/paste: 
```js
// OLD
await client.stream({ prompt: "Summarize the doc" })
// NEW
await client.stream({ input_text: "Summarize the doc" })
```

vivian (docs): Timeline: Docs preview + SDK patch tomorrow AM, canary flip within 48h. Deprecation window: 30 days post-flip. Banner + changelog entry will be added.

ci-bot: Docs preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/1518 (:eyes:)
